sources.title: 穎崴大擴產1／輝達、超微都靠穎崴 揭測試探針廠成晶片出廠關鍵原因
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning「本刊調查，目前全球前20大半導體廠中」
sources.note: Reports「近9成」as the publication's own investigation, but provides no list, ranking source, or measurement period.

sources.title: 穎崴科技股份有限公司｜104人力銀行公司介紹
sources.locator: 公司簡介 paragraph beginning「測試領導廠商穎崴創立於2001年」
sources.note: Repeats the near-90% claim on an employer profile; the underlying top-20 definition and period are not given, and the profile is not an independent verification.

sources.title: 穎崴續攻先進製程 7奈米以下營收比重近九成

sources.note: Issuer states it develops test-interface solutions for high-end computing and that AI/HPC applications accounted for 42% of shipments through May 2025.

sources.title: 2025 Annual Report
sources.note: Issuer reports that 2025 was an exceptional year, driven by strong momentum in AI, HPC, and ASIC.

sources.title: 穎崴科技2024年第2季財報新聞稿
sources.note: Issuer reports strong AI/HPC demand and related customer demand; this is corroborative context, not evidence for the top-20 customer statistic.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
已查閱 issuer disclosures、年報與報導及雇主公司簡介；AI/HPC業務關聯有支持，但未找到能定義並核對「全球前20大」名單、期間與客戶口徑的資料，因此該原子主張維持UNKNOWN並停止研究。
「全球前20大半導體廠」沒有指定排名機構、排名年份或企業範圍；來源未列出20家名單。
公司披露的42%是截至2025年5月的AI/HPC應用出貨占比，不能替代營收占比或客戶數驗證。
「賣鏟子」及「AI軍備競賽」屬比喻性描述；可驗證的部分是公司產品與AI/HPC需求、業務表現的關聯。
